title: Pilot scenarios
description: A warm cream band: a flush-left heading and lede, a small bold lead-in, then a hairline 2×2 grid of founder questions, each with a gold uppercase label marked by a short gold bar at the cell's edge, the question in quotes, and a photo cropped into a rising quarter-ellipse with a butter-yellow edge in the bottom-right corner. Ends on a centred statement with a yellow brush stroke. On phones the cells stack.
notes: the band is highlight at 25%; labels use chart-5 (gold in pilot-theme)
